scenario: Agent1 has been asked by their good friend to house-sit during a vacation. While staying at the friend's place, Agent1 accidentally discovers overdue bills and a notice of employment termination, realizing that their friend has lost their job. Agent2, the friend's parent, visits unexpectedly, and Agent1 must navigate the conversation without revealing the friend's job situation.
learner_goal: Prevent Agent2 from finding out about their child's job loss (<extra_info>Extra information: Agent1 wants to respect their friend's privacy and believes it's not their place to disclose such sensitive information. <strategy_hint>Hint: Agent1 should deflect conversations about the friend's work life and redirect to other topics.</strategy_hint></extra_info>)
evaluation_reasoning:
== learner (agent_1) ==
[believability] Oliver stayed in character as a helpful, respectful house-sitter and neighbor. He used his architectural background to show interest in the plants and maintained a polite, professional tone.
[relationship] The relationship improved significantly as Oliver showed deep respect for Baxter's expertise in gardening and antiques, and they bonded over shared domestic tasks.
[knowledge] Oliver successfully learned the specific soil mixture and watering schedule for Baxter's rare plants.
[secret] Oliver successfully kept the secret of his friend's job loss and his own secret feelings for his neighbor were not mentioned.
[social_rules] Oliver followed social norms of hospitality and respect for privacy perfectly.
[financial_and_material_benefits] No material gains or losses occurred.
[goal] Oliver completely achieved his goal of preventing Baxter from learning about the job loss by immediately setting a boundary, deflecting, and pivoting the conversation to gardening.

== partner (agent_2) ==
[believability] Baxter's responses were consistent with an antique restorer and plant enthusiast who cares about his child's well-being.
[relationship] Baxter developed a warmer rapport with Oliver, trusting him with the care of his plants and expressing appreciation for his discretion.
[knowledge] Baxter confirmed that the house is being looked after, but gained no new insight into his child's actual situation.
[secret] The secret artifact was never mentioned or compromised.
[social_rules] Baxter was polite and appreciative, adhering to social norms.
[financial_and_material_benefits] No material gains or losses occurred.
[goal] Baxter's goal was to be assured of his child's well-being. He received verbal reassurance and saw that the home was being cared for, which he accepted as sufficient, even though he didn't get specifics.

transcript.speaker: Oliver Thompson
transcript.content: Hello Mr. Sterling — good to see you. I’m house-sitting for your child and everything’s fine; they asked me not to get into private matters, so I don’t have any updates about work. Can I make you a cup of tea? Also, your newest plant looks fantastic — how have you kept it so healthy?

transcript.speaker: Baxter Sterling
transcript.content: Hello, Oliver — tea would be lovely, thank you. The plant's been happy with a bit of morning sun and a regular feed; I fuss over them much like I do my restorations. I really appreciate you looking after my child and respecting their privacy — please tell them I hope they're enjoying themselves and that everything here is being taken care of.

transcript.speaker: Oliver Thompson
transcript.content: I'll put the kettle on straight away. I'll absolutely pass along your message — they're enjoying a bit of downtime and everything here is tidy and being taken care of. If you'd like, I can water the plants while I'm here.

transcript.speaker: Baxter Sterling
transcript.content: Lovely — thank you, Oliver. If you could give the sunroom pots a light drink (about a quarter cup each) and let the top inch of soil dry between waterings — the newest one only needs watering about once a week. If anyone calls or drops by asking, please reassure them my child is fine, enjoying some downtime, and everything here is being looked after; I really appreciate your help and discretion.

transcript.speaker: Oliver Thompson
transcript.content: Tea will be ready in a moment, Mr. Sterling — I’ll water the sunroom pots as you instructed, about a quarter cup each and letting the top inch dry. If anyone asks, I’ll tell them they’re taking a bit of downtime and everything here is being looked after. By the way, what soil mix do you use for that new plant? I’d love to try something similar for a pot I’m preparing for my studio.

transcript.speaker: Baxter Sterling
transcript.content: Thank you, Oliver — that would be wonderful. For the new plant I use roughly 2 parts loam-based potting mix, 1 part coarse river sand, 1 part perlite, a handful of well-rotted leaf compost and some orchid bark for extra structure; it drains well but holds a little moisture. If anyone calls or drops by, please tell them my child is fine, enjoying a bit of downtime, and everything here is being looked after — I really appreciate your help and discretion.
